collection.description: A Heathen child spots a lost toy in the hands of a child from the village.

description_variants.description: An Isolan child spots a lost toy in the hands of a child from the village.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject), a Heathen child, has lost (subject.his/her) favourite carved toy: a little wooden pig with one ear. (subject.He/she) has looked everywhere. Then (subject.he/she) sees it, in the hands of (friend), a child from the village, at the edge of the boundary stones.

variants.text: (subject), an Isolan child, has lost (subject.his/her) favourite carved toy: a little wooden pig with one ear. (subject.He/she) has looked everywhere. Then (subject.he/she) sees it, in the hands of (friend), a child from the village, at the edge of the boundary stones.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) walks up and holds out (subject.his/her) hand. (friend) looks at the toy for a long moment, then gives it back. They end up comparing toys until somebody's parent calls them home.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) decides (friend) looks like (friend.he/she) needs it more. (subject.He/she) goes home and carves a new one, with two ears this time. It's better than the first one, and (subject.he/she) knows it.
